options_en.A: Reduce the volume of data that is used in training.

question_en: A company wants to use large language models (LLMs) with Amazon Bedrock to develop a chat interface for the company's product manuals. The manuals are stored as PDF files. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
question_cn: 某公司希望结合Amazon Bedrock的大语言模型（LLM）为产品手册开发聊天界面，手册以PDF文件存储。哪种解决方案能以最低成本满足需求？

options_en.A: Use prompt engineering to add one PDF file as context to the user prompt when the prompt is submitted to Amazon Bedrock.
options_en.B: Use prompt engineering to add all the PDF files as context to the user prompt when the prompt is submitted to Amazon Bedrock.
options_en.C: Use all the PDF documents to fine-tune a model with Amazon Bedrock. Use the fine-tuned model to process user prompts.
options_en.D: Upload PDF documents to an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base. Use the knowledge base to provide context when users submit prompts to Amazon Bedrock.

options_cn.A: 在用户提交提示词至Amazon Bedrock时，通过提示词工程将单个PDF文件作为上下文添加到提示词中
options_cn.B: 在用户提交提示词至Amazon Bedrock时，通过提示词工程将所有PDF文件作为上下文添加到提示词中
options_cn.C: 使用所有PDF文档在Amazon Bedrock中微调模型，再用微调后的模型处理用户提示词
options_cn.D: 将PDF文档上传至Amazon Bedrock知识库，在用户提交提示词时利用知识库提供上下文

question_en: A company wants to use a pre-trained generative AI model to generate content for its marketing campaigns. The company needs to ensure that the generated content aligns with the company's brand voice and messaging requirements. Which solution meets these requirements?
question_cn: 某公司希望使用预训练生成式AI模型为营销活动生成内容，且需确保生成的内容符合企业的品牌语气和信息传递要求。哪种解决方案能满足需求？

options_en.A: Optimize the model's architecture and hyperparameters to improve the model's overall performance.
options_en.B: Increase the model's complexity by adding more layers to the model's architecture.
options_en.C: Create effective prompts that provide clear instructions and context to guide the model's generation.
options_en.D: Select a large, diverse dataset to pre-train a new generative model.

options_cn.A: 优化模型架构和超参数以提升模型整体性能
options_cn.B: 通过为模型架构增加更多层来提高模型复杂度
options_cn.C: 创建有效的提示词，提供清晰的指令和上下文以引导模型生成内容
options_cn.D: 选择大型多样化数据集来预训练新的生成式模型

question_en: (多选题)A loan company is building a generative AI-based solution to offer new applicants discounts based on specific business criteria. The company wants to build and use an AI model responsibly to minimize bias that could negatively affect some customers. Which actions should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
question_cn: (多选题)某贷款公司正在构建基于生成式AI的解决方案，用于根据特定业务标准为新申请人提供折扣。公司希望负责任地构建和使用AI模型，以最大程度减少可能对部分客户产生负面影响的偏差。公司应采取哪些措施满足需求？（选择两项）

options_en.A: Detect imbalances or disparities in the data.
options_en.B: Ensure that the model runs frequently.
options_en.C: Evaluate the model's behavior so that the company can provide transparency to stakeholders.
options_en.D: Use the Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE) technique to ensure that the model is 100% accurate.
options_en.E: Ensure that the model's inference time is within the accepted limits.

options_cn.A: 检测数据中的不平衡或差异
options_cn.C: 评估模型行为，以便向利益相关者提供透明度
options_cn.D: 使用基于召回率的摘要评估（ROUGE）技术确保模型100%准确
options_cn.E: 确保模型的推理时间在可接受范围内

question_cn: 某公司正在使用Amazon Bedrock基础模型为内部场景进行文档摘要，且已训练自定义模型以提升摘要质量。公司需执行哪项操作才能通过Amazon Bedrock使用该自定义模型？

question_en: A digital devices company wants to predict customer demand for memory hardware. The company does not have coding experience or knowledge of ML algorithms and needs to develop a data-driven predictive model. The company needs to perform analysis on internal data and external data. Which solution will meet these requirements?
question_cn: 某数码设备公司希望预测客户对存储硬件的需求，该公司无编码经验和机器学习算法知识，但需开发数据驱动的预测模型，且要对内部和外部数据进行分析。哪种解决方案能满足需求？

options_en.A: Store the data in Amazon S3. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using Amazon SageMaker built-in algorithms that use the data from Amazon S3.
options_en.B: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Create ML models and demand forecast predictions by using SageMaker built-in algorithms.
options_en.C: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by using an Amazon Personalize Trending-Now recipe.
options_en.D: Import the data into Amazon SageMaker Canvas. Build ML models and demand forecast predictions by selecting the values in the data from SageMaker Canvas.

options_cn.A: 将数据存储在Amazon S3，使用Amazon SageMaker内置算法基于S3数据构建机器学习模型并生成需求预测
options_cn.B: 将数据导入Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler，使用SageMaker内置算法构建机器学习模型并生成需求预测
options_cn.C: 将数据导入Amazon SageMaker Data Wrangler，使用Amazon Personalize热门推荐配方构建机器学习模型并生成需求预测
options_cn.D: 将数据导入Amazon SageMaker Canvas，通过在Canvas中选择数据相关数值来构建机器学习模型并生成需求预测
